text: Playing with friends? Found a camp together. A camp is a named group with one shared vault, devices every member can use, and tribe standing pooled between you.
pages.title: Shared camps
One camp, many hands
pages.text: Everything a member places opens for the whole camp.

pages.title: Founding and inviting
text: Run **/tribalpower camp create <name>** (up to 24 characters). You become its first member and its leader.

To invite someone, run **/tribalpower camp invite <player>**, or craft a **Camp Charter** and right-click the player with it. The charter is never used up. Right-clicking the air with it shows your camp.
An invitation lasts **five minutes**. The invitee accepts with **/tribalpower camp join <name>**.
You can only belong to one camp at a time.

pages.title: What members share
text: - **Devices.** Members count as owners of each other's cradles, tenders, anchors, keystones and locked menus.
- **The vault.** Any Deep Cache or Wayfarer Satchel opens the camp's shared **54-slot** vault. Crouch as you open one to switch between that and your personal vault; it remembers your choice.
- **Standing.** A quarter of every member's tribe standing lands on the camp, and a Tribal Kin Elder trades at the camp's rank when it beats your own.
- **Anchors.** The camp shares **12** Wayanchors, counted across every world.

pages.title: Running the camp
text: **/tribalpower camp info** lists members and anchors. The leader can **rename** the camp and **kick** members. Anyone can **leave**.
When the last member leaves, the camp dissolves and its vault spills out at their feet.
Kinship Totems can lend your camp every tribe's voice once the tribes know you.
